LanguageData.LetterLabelZombielandMapSetupFailed: Zombieland did not start on this map
LanguageData.ZombielandMapSetupFailed:
RimWorld loaded this map, but Zombieland could not finish its map setup. Zombieland tried to repair the problem and could not.

What this means: zombies will not spawn or move on this map. Zombie events, zombie avoidance, zombie corpses, and special zombie behavior may not work here.

This is usually caused by an error while RimWorld or another mod was loading the map. Check the first red error earlier in the log, then try disabling recently added or updated mods. Also make sure RimWorld and Zombieland are compatible versions.

LanguageData.ZombieSymbiant:
A Zombie Symbiant has surfaced in {0} and linked itself to {1}. It spreads through busy indoor rooms. Pawns crossing it are slowed, except the host. The host is immune to zombie infection from bites and gains random benefits as the Symbiant grows. Feed it corpses to make it grow faster.

Keep host and Symbiant on the same map: if they are separated, the bond goes dormant and cannot be removed while it sleeps. It wakes up again only when the same host and Symbiant are back on one map. Abandoning the Symbiant's map destroys it and forcibly breaks the bond.

Operate on {1} first to remove the bond safely; the unbound Symbiant will shrink away.

LanguageData.SymbiantHostBondDescription:
Symbiant: {0}/{1} cells. Next benefit at {2} cells. Shared health: {3}. When the host is hit, the full attack drains shared health first; <color=#ffb35c>{4}%</color> remains as a real host injury at the current size. Attacks on the Symbiant leave only harmless grey entries in the health record instead of real injuries.

Map rule: host and Symbiant must be on the same map. If separated, the bond goes dormant and cannot be removed by surgery. It wakes up again only when the same host and Symbiant are back on one map. Abandoning the Symbiant's map destroys it and forcibly breaks the bond; removing the bond by surgery first is the safe way.
